heroV4.headline:
Mold Removal & Remediation
in Vancouver, WA
heroV4.body:
Mold can develop when moisture is allowed to remain in a property after a leak, flood, plumbing problem, or other water intrusion. Musty odors, visible discoloration, and recurring moisture can all be signs that mold may be present beyond the surface. Simply cleaning or painting over visible mold does not address the underlying moisture or contaminated materials, and disturbing mold without proper containment can spread spores to other areas of the property.

Spartan Restoration provides mold removal and remediation for residential and commercial properties throughout Vancouver, Clark County, and the Portland metro area. We identify affected areas, isolate the work area when appropriate, remove contaminated materials, and use HEPA filtration and cleaning methods to help control airborne particles and contamination. Our work follows IICRC-informed restoration practices, with an emphasis on addressing the source of the moisture and restoring affected areas as safely and thoroughly as possible.

heroV4.headline:
Storm & Sewage Cleanup
in Vancouver, WA
heroV4.body:
Storm damage and sewage backups can create serious problems for a property in a matter of hours. Heavy Pacific Northwest rain can lead to flooding, roof and exterior water intrusion, while backed-up sewer lines can introduce contaminated water into floors, walls, and other areas of a home or business. The longer affected materials remain wet or contaminated, the greater the potential for structural damage, persistent odors, and mold growth.

Spartan Restoration provides storm and sewage cleanup to help stabilize your property and begin the recovery process. Our team can extract standing water, remove affected materials when necessary, clean and sanitize contaminated areas, and begin drying the structure to help prevent further damage. We serve homes and businesses throughout Vancouver, Clark County, and the Portland metro area. If your property has been affected by a storm or sewage backup, contact Spartan Restoration and tell us what happened so we can help determine the next steps.

heroV4.headline:
Water Damage Restoration
in Vancouver, WA
heroV4.body:
Water damage can happen quickly from a burst or leaking pipe, failed appliance, overflowing fixture, roof intrusion, or other unexpected source. Once water enters a property, it can move into flooring, drywall, insulation, cabinets, and structural materials that may not be obvious at first. Fast extraction and drying can help limit additional damage and reduce the risk of long-term problems such as mold, odors, and deterioration of building materials.

Spartan Restoration provides water damage restoration for homes and businesses throughout Vancouver, Clark County, and the Portland metro area. We respond by identifying the affected areas, extracting standing water, setting up structural drying equipment, and monitoring the drying process to help return the property to a stable condition. We also provide clear documentation throughout the restoration process so you understand what was affected, what work is being performed, and what comes next.
